description: This file contains shell script functions for managing U-Boot environment configurations via UCI (Unified Configuration Interface), specifically adding and configuring U-Boot environment variables and system configurations on an OpenWrt-based system.

methods.name: _ubootenv_add_uci_config
methods.description: Adds U-Boot environment configuration entries using UCI commands.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_uci_config
methods.description: Wrapper function that calls _ubootenv_add_uci_config for 'ubootenv' configuration type.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_uci_sys_config
methods.description: Wrapper function that calls _ubootenv_add_uci_config for 'ubootsys' configuration type.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_app_config
methods.description: Adds application-specific U-Boot environment configuration, appending to a config file if certain conditions are not met.
